ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface, exceeding 90% coverage, with high-contrast high-intensity (white) linear disruptions and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation field spanning the entire visible area, interrupted by high-intensity pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered linear white pixel paths across the central and lower lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge topography characterized by low-frequency serrations and a prominent rounded protrusion located on the inner margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a moderate convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, with the tips exhibiting a slight upward vertical deflection relative to the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters with irregular circular morphology localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of high-contrast, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (scratches) distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes, particularly dense in the lower-central regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, unaligned linear rake marks across both lobes; significant white clusters on distal tips consistent with localized scarring or parasitic colonization.
